name: Comprehensive Multi-Channel Campaign & Performance Audit
purpose: Conduct deep programmatic audits of live campaigns across Google, Meta, and TikTok to identify wasted spend, fatigued creatives, audience overlap, and tracking anomalies.
triggerConditions: Performance drop alert triggered by Heartbeat
User prompt requesting account or campaign audit
prerequisites: Active campaigns running for at least 7 days
Platform adapters connected with read permissions
Baseline benchmark KPI targets established from industry template

executionSteps.name: Extract Multi-Channel Performance Metrics
executionSteps.action: Query last 7, 14, and 30-day performance data (Spend, Impressions, Clicks, Conversions, ROAS, CPA) via platform adapters

executionSteps.name: Detect Wasted Spend & Bleeding Ad Sets
executionSteps.action: Flag search queries with zero conversions and spend > 2x target CPA; flag ad sets with high frequency and crashing CTR

executionSteps.name: Audit Creative Fatigue & Saturation
executionSteps.action: Identify ads with frequency > 3.5 and declining 7-day ROAS; rank creatives by first-3-second hook retention

executionSteps.name: Audit Conversion Tracking Integrity
executionSteps.action: Compare browser vs. server-side event counts; check event deduplication rates and GA4 attribution discrepancies

executionSteps.name: Calculate Account Health Score & Action Plan
executionSteps.action: Synthesize a 100-point account health score across Structure, Bidding, Creative, and Tracking with prioritized recommendations

successCriteria: 100% of live campaigns audited across all active channels
Accurate identification of bleeding ad sets with verifiable spend data

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry platform metric fetch up to 2 times with 10s cooldown if rate-limited

rollbackStrategy: Read-only operation; no changes applied to live ad accounts. Cached metrics retained if partial fetch fails.
